payload.body: For the WP01 re-bank, from WP06b's critic: lib/cmd/release:710 captures release_commit with 2>&1 and takes everything before the first tab as the commit, so git's stderr on a successful read (GIT_TRACE, a tag naming a tree) lands inside the sha; :3108 captures stdout alone. Make :710 capture stdout alone as :3108 does. release_commit itself (WP06b) goes quiet on success and re-runs a failing read with stderr open, so git's words still print. FYI only -- no response needed.
